product.title: Seattle Pike Market Food Tour with 8 Authentic Local Tastings

description.text: Discover Pike Place Market on a Secret Food Tours walking route with eight authentic local tastings including clam chowder, piroshki, and artisan sweets. The tour explores main market levels and the DownUnder area with a licensed market guide.

highlights: Eight curated Pike Place Market tastings
Licensed tour in the historic market district
Sample clam chowder and local artisan foods
Explore market lanes and the DownUnder level

start.description: Meet in front of Sur La Table at 84 Pine Street, Seattle, WA 98101.

end.description: Tour ends near Pike Place Market by the Gum Wall.

product.itinerarySummary: Discover Pike Place Market on a Secret Food Tours walking route with eight authentic local tastings including clam chowder, piroshki, and artisan sweets.

itineraryItems.title: Sur La Table meeting point

itineraryItems.title: Market food stops

itineraryItems.title: Pike Place DownUnder
itineraryItems.description: Descend to the DownUnder level for vendor scenes and North Pacific fishing traditions.
